draft.subject: One quick step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

I know a few notes from us have landed in your inbox already, so I'll keep this to one thing.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is usually what makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Fifteen minutes and I can stay with you while you set up that first project.

Best,
Chidi
